description:
Option C, step C3 (approved page https://claude.ai/artifact/HJ4StaQ4ggt6yt2Fus6pX7).

- lib/ marks the externs that project a value (an extern mark).
- Arity, MapSize and ByteSize become matrix questions.
- fz_tuple_size lowers onto TupleArity.
- Narrowing happens on the match edge.

is_struct/1 and is_exception/1 become type tests by this route (Make Distiller Fast finding 4).

Removes: option A's guard_domain table (fz-yh5.8, #842, the holding position).

Moved here from fz-yh5.11 (Callables, 2026-11-24): removing the guard leaf's Whole read of a callable (executable_facts.rs:656). Once fz_function_arity becomes the Arity question, is_function(g, 2) (probe u6) and p15 lose their wrapper.

## Folded in from fz-yh5.8 (user decision 2026-11-25: #842 is closed and option A never merges)

C3 now carries fz-yh5.8's job. OTP's `:lists.foldl` guard `when is_function(F, 2)` must not by itself make Enum.reduce's reducer cross the boxed seam. A type test asks a question about a value; it does not use the value.

- Today: Enum.each over a list builds two construction wrappers where it should build none. The distiller costs +11.8% requests; that figure is fz-mue.44's report, from Elixir Parity's distill_{base,a,b}.log.
- Acceptance: with `is_function(F, 2)` as the Arity question on the match edge, mue.44's shape builds no wrapper.
- Tests: compiler2_never_boxed_discarded_closure_call_delivers_no_lanes and compiler2_no_value_reaches_a_construction_member_that_never_named_it.
- This ticket blocks fz-mue.44 in fz-yh5.8's place. The is_function arity ticket fz-yh5.7 is related.
- #842's branch fz-yh5.8/guard-domain-table (head 0a1c2e2d1) is kept on the remote as a reference: its domain_at_literals and guard_domain table show the literal-argument cases C3's questions must cover.
title: A projecting extern compared with a constant is a matrix question
